application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered Location Plan, 22014-4901-P1, 22014-4999-P1, 22014-5000-P1, 22014-5001-P1, 22014-5002-P1, 22014-5003-P1, 22014-5004-P1, 22014-5020-P1, 22014-5021-P1, 22014-5022-P1, 22014-5025-P1, 22014-5100-P1, 22014-5101-P1, 22014-5102-P1, 22014-5103-P1, 22014-5120-P1, 22014-5121-P1, 22014-5122-P1, 22014-5125-P1, 22014-5199-P1, 22014-5200-P1, 22014-5202-P1, 22014-5203-P1, 22014-5204-P1, 22014-5221-P1, 22014-5222-P1, 22014-5225-P1, Cover Letter dated on 5th February 2026, Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment 23020-FCE-XX-XX-RP-D-0001, Flood Response Plan 230200-FCE-XX-XX-RP-D-0002, Arboricultural Impact Assessment Report MM/150PKR/AIA/01c and Fire Safety Statement. Received: 17/02/2026
22014-5201-P2 and 22014-5220-P2. Received: 01/04/2026].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the [insert] elevation of the development hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.
Condition : 5 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays. 

Reason: In the interests of road safety
Condition : 6 - The extensions hereby approved shall be used solely as part of the house known as 150 Park Road, Chiswick W4 3HP and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling nor used for business purposes and the premises shall not be used as a house in multiple occupation, including any use within Class C4 of The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or such other legislation as may subsequently supersede it. 

Reason: To protect the character of the locality, to ensure that adequate living standards are and to prevent unacceptable disturbance to neighbours.
Condition : 7 - The proposed development should be carried out according to the approved Arboricultural Impact Assessment Report MM/150PKR/AIA/01c.

Reasons: To protect the character of the locality.
description: Erection of a part single storey, part two storey side extension following the demolition of the garage along with the erection of a single storey rear extension, raising of the party wall with no.148 to facilitate the provision of a second floor outrigger mansard roof, a front dormer extension and landscaping works to the front and rear gardens
